articles.title: US rejects EU plans to tax Big Tech
articles.desc: The United States warned Thursday against European Union plans for a tax on Big Tech, as EU leaders discussed the proposal at a fraught Brussels summit focused on the bloc's next long-term budget. "We oppose the EU proposal for an EU-wide digital levy just as we have opposed (and continue to oppose) other digital services taxes that discriminate against US companies while hurting consumers as well," a US State Department spokesperson told AFP. The idea of a levy on the world's largest digital firms was put forward by Brussels as the union seeks new ways to fund its budget amid deep division among member states over the spending plans.
